messages:
jen: deploybot failed canary apply, holding promotion. helm apply error during templating, looks like a parse fail
deploy-bot: Canary deployment for release 2026.03.20 (canary-7) FAILED on cluster eu-west-1: helm template error
sam: can you paste the error?
maria: pinging deploybot logs + checking chart version
jen: error snippet:
```
Error: template: myapp/templates/deployment.yaml:23:12: executing "myapp/templates/deployment.yaml" at <printf "%s" .Values.env.SECRET>: error calling printf: invalid format: unknown verb \"s\"
```
alex: hmm looks like someone put an unescaped % or printf in the secret value itself, helm's printf is interpreting it
ci-bot: recent merge landed env secret update in chart v1.4.3 -> v1.5.0 (PR #912)
sam: @release-manager we should hold mainline promotion until this is resolved. Can we pin charts to 1.4.3 for the rollout?
release-manager: yes hold. Do not promote canary. Notify product about the change window impact (we're in the 3–4pm UTC slot).
maria: quick mitigation: rollback to chart 1.4.3 on canary and pin value in values.yaml to avoid printf call. I'll open rollback PR and a hotfix PR to sanitize env var encoding.
jen: rolling back now, running `deploybot promote --to=1.4.3 --target=canary-7`
deploy-bot: Promotion queued: promote chart myapp:1.4.3 -> canary-7. Will apply and report status.
deploy-bot: Promotion completed: canary-7 now running myapp:1.4.3 (pods Ready=3/3).
alex: thanks. we still need a proper fix though — automatic escaping for any user-supplied printf format sequences in envs. Maria, assign on the hotfix PR?
maria: yep created PR #946: sanitize-env-values -> escapes % and disables printf usage in templates. Added unit test for values containing % signs.
ci-bot: PR #946 CI: unit + lint passed, integration job currently running.
sam: decision: do NOT promote main until PR #946 merged and a post-merge canary passes in next change window. Also add explicit chart pin in the release notes so ops know the temporary pin.
release-manager: I'll update release notes and notify stakeholders. Add entry: "Hold: promotion delayed due to helm templating parse on env var percent signs; rollback to chart 1.4.3; hotfix PR #946 in flight; next change window target."
jen: tagging this thread in the release doc and adding a note in #incidents in case customers ask. :warning:
alex: follow-up: add a CI lint rule to fail if templates use printf on raw values. Filed ticket INFRA-841.
jen: thanks everyone — keeping this pinned. Will reopen promotion thread once canary passes and release-manager signs off. :thumbsup:
